open_issues: IQuickCaptureService.CaptureTaskAsync takes no note, so W94's «ملاحظة (اختياري)» is written through the package-local ITaskNotes (src/Wakeel.UI/Services/Shell/TaskNotes.cs). If the note belongs on the task entity, the accepted B2 Core service should grow the parameter and TaskNotes should go.

W94's export draws «الربط بمراسلة (اختياري)» where the host draws «المكلّف (اختياري)». The correspondence records and their picker belong to B4, so there is nothing to link to yet; the field should be swapped back when B4 lands.

WTabs (a B0 design-system component) draws its selected tab as an underline, while every export — W08, W09, W12 — draws it as a filled pill carrying the count badge. It is a visible, repeated deviation on three of my screens but it is shared by every package's screens, so I did not restyle it unprompted. It needs one decision at the design-system level.

W09's export carries a header action «تصدير القائمة» and a filter row («تصفية», «الأكثر تأخرًا أولًا», «أطول تأخر: N يومًا») that the B2 spec's W09 row does not list. The host has «تحديث» and the local search only. Either the spec row or the export should be reconciled.

W08's monthly-report banner shows 0% and «لم تُحسب بنود الجاهزية بعد» because ReadinessService does not exist yet; the spec allows that («أو 0 مؤقتًا»). It should be re-checked when that service lands.

The W08 export fits the phone-expenses section at 1366x768 with three rows in «يحتاج إجراء اليوم»; the host seed has six, so the expenses section falls below the fold. Data-driven, not a layout defect, but worth re-checking against a realistic dataset.
notes:
STARTING STATE. docs/build/progress/b2-screens.md showed pass 2 had already closed all sixteen findings of review1-b2-screens.json (4 high, 5 medium, 7 low) and both actionable carry-over findings of verify-b2-carryover.json (the third explicitly said "no change required in this package"). I re-checked each in the code and, for the ones that are only observable live, in the running host. What remained was the verification the cut-off agent never finished: a green build/test chain, a host run on an activated installation, screenshots of every screen light and dark, and the side-by-side comparison with the exports. That comparison found six real deviations, which I fixed.

FINDINGS RE-VERIFIED IN THE RUNNING HOST, not just in the diff:
- HIGH 2+4 (invisible «تراجع»): saved a real quick capture over CDP and measured the toast — «تراجع» is rgb(255,255,255) on the strip's rgb(49,115,93), about 5.3:1, plainly legible. The strip is WUndoToast in Wakeel.Design, not a page-local toast.
- HIGH 1 (host crash on unlock): the gate is in ShellServices and every page DB call routes through it; the host ran through sign-in, five screens, a save and an undo with a log holding exactly one «[INF] Wakeel desktop host starting up» line and nothing else.
- HIGH 3 / MEDIUM 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 and the seven lows: present in the code and visible in the screenshots (the panel hangs from the bell, W09 pages its table, W92's tooltips, W91's tinted state icons, W12's strip).

WHAT THE SIDE-BY-SIDE COMPARISON ADDED (deviation -> fix):
1. Every table carried a permanent horizontal scrollbar and every header a stray 21px of scroll. Root cause was NOT the tables: WTooltip's resting bubble was `visibility:hidden`, which still counts towards the scrollable overflow of every scrolling ancestor. Measured W08's table at scrollWidth 779 vs clientWidth 702 and .w-page-header at 1089 vs 1068; hiding the bubbles from script collapsed both to the client width exactly. Fixed by taking the bubble out of the layout at rest (display:none -> display:block on hover/focus-within) with the fade preserved through allow-discrete + @starting-style. Re-measured live afterwards: 692/692, 1058/1058, and W09's seven columns 1077/1077. This one defect was visible on W08, W09 and W12.
2. W12: the export puts «آخر فحص» on every tile's start edge. WHealthCard rendered the action first, so tiles WITH an action pushed the timestamp to the opposite edge from tiles without one and the grid's timestamps zig-zagged. Footer order swapped.
3. W10: the export puts the kind's icon square on the row's start edge and the unread dot on its end edge. WNotificationItem was built mirrored. Order swapped; verified live (icon at offset 324 of a 380px row, dot at 12).
4. W94: the priority select showed no chevron at all. WSelect pinned the caret to inset-inline-start, i.e. underneath the right-aligned Arabic value, while the 34px of padding the control reserves sat empty on the other side. Moved to inset-inline-end; the chevron now sits where the export draws it.
5. W91: the third row of reference states was cut off at 1366x768, where the export fits all thirteen. Tightened WStateCard to the export's density (16px padding, 6px gap, 40px icon circle, no extra icon margin). All thirteen cards and their buttons are now visible.
6. W92: the page used a uniform two-up grid; the export is three short dialogs on the first row and the two field/version dialogs on the second. Rebuilt as six tracks (span 2 / span 3) and moved «تم تحديث هذا السجل» into third place so the reading order matches. All five surfaces now fit the window.

W11 could not be photographed before, because the banner only appears when the machine clock fails its check. Rather than touch the machine's clock I added an opt-in WAKEEL_HOST_SKEW_CLOCK to HostDataFolderSeed that writes a ClockCheck dated two days ahead — exactly what a clock turned back looks like to ClockCheckService. W11 then rendered with its three exact texts («ساعة الجهاز غير صحيحة», the explanation, «لن تُصدر أرقام رسمية حتى التصحيح») and both buttons, and HealthService independently flipped W12's clock card to «عطل» with «مزامنة الوقت», which is a nice cross-check that the two agree.

SCREEN-BY-SCREEN COMPARISON (host screenshot beside design/exports/preview/{light,dark}/W):
W08 — matches: same column order (main to the start, side column to the end), same four KPI cards in the same order with semantic colours, banner at the identical y (299px in both), tabs+search on the section-header row, meetings as key/value rows with the hour at the end, sync/backup as rows with chips. Banner text follows the CURRENT cycle («دورة سبتمبر 2026»), not the export's «دورة أكتوبر». Accepted deviations: 0% readiness (no ReadinessService yet, spec allows it) and the expenses section below the fold because the seed has six action rows where the export has three.
W09 — matches: the seven spec'd columns, badge tabs, local search, attention edge on the row's start, «معالجة» in the last cell, footer range, pager when there is more than one page. Accepted: the export's extra «تصدير القائمة» and filter/sort strip are not in the spec's W09 row.
W10 — matches after fix 3: 380px panel hanging from the bell, «الإشعارات» + count at the start, «تحديد الكل كمقروء», gear at the end, real «الكل 5» / «غير المقروء 4», relative times, tinted row, «عرض كل الإشعارات» footer. Accepted: day heads («اليوم», «أمس») that the export does not draw — NotificationService returns the panel already grouped by day and the heads are WSectionHeader, not hand-rolled.
W11 — matches: icon at the start, title, explanation, numbering notice, «تصحيح الساعة» + «تجاهل مؤقتًا» at the end. Accepted: the export folds the numbering notice into the body sentence (two lines); the spec asks for it as its own part, so the host renders three. The title wording comes from the accepted Core service, not this package.
W12 — matches after fix 2: same grid, same chips, tinted grounds per state in both themes, timestamps now aligned down every column. Accepted: the red summary strip the export does not draw is required verbatim by the spec's HealthService row («ملخص أعلى: ... هناك N مشكلة تحتاج تدخلًا»).
W91 — matches after fix 5: 5/5/3 cards in the export's order with the same icons, tints and buttons, and the «تحديث» header action.
W92 — matches after fix 6.
W94 — matches after fix 4: same five kind tiles in the same order with the same icons, same required stars, same helper lines, same two-up row, same footer. Accepted: «المكلّف (اختياري)» where the export has «الربط بمراسلة (اختياري)» — there are no correspondence records to link to until B4.
Dark theme checked on W09 and W12 against the dark exports: same anatomy, tints invert correctly, the dialog notice strip is legible.

HOUSEKEEPING. No NuGet package added. Nothing outside the allowed paths was touched (the Wakeel.Admin/Admin.UI/Core churn in git status belongs to concurrent packages and I left it alone). No new Arabic string was introduced — the four component fixes are markup order and CSS only. No technical term, error code, port, server or database wording anywhere. Four new bUnit tests pin the four component fixes so they cannot silently revert. The host process was killed after the run (0 left) and its log was read in full.
